translation_zh: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。

text_en: We yawn when we are short of oxygen.
translation_zh: 我们缺氧时就会打哈欠。

text_en: Do not yell into my ear.
translation_zh: 別在我耳邊大叫。

text_en: If you got anything to say, say it properly, don't yell.
translation_zh: 有事好好说，不要大喊大叫！

text_en: The youth of our land are not interested in politics.
translation_zh: 我們國家的年輕人對政治普遍不感興趣。

text_en: My father must have been handsome in his youth.
translation_zh: 我爸爸年轻的时候一定很英俊。

text_en: You need to get out of your comfort zone.
translation_zh: 你需要离开你的舒适区。

text_en: It's like a war zone there.
translation_zh: 那里就像战场一样。
